rationale: The breakout above the $12.00 whole-dollar resistance failed, with the most recent 1-minute candle flushing back down to $11.90 on a massive 366k volume spike (roughly 10x the prior consolidation volume) and price continuing lower to $11.88. Because the core entry premise was immediate continuation above $12.00, this heavy-volume rejection invalidates the thesis ahead of the hard stop, though the strongly bullish broader market (SPY +2.07%) and proximity to the rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($11.81) argue against flipping short.
